Problem Statement:
Write a program to compute the factorial of a given number.
Factorial of N is N! = N × (N-1) × (N-2) ... × 1. 
Input Description:
A single integer N (0 ≤ N ≤ 20). 
Output Description:
Print the factorial of N. 
Sample Input:
5 
Sample Output:
120
